fusions.name: Vaulting Bash
fusions.desc: Leaps up to 7 tiles onto the target and brings your shield down on it, dealing 13 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Skyfall Landing
fusions.desc: Springs impossibly high and lands shield-first, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. A boss or elite hit also loses 5% of its maximum health.

fusions.name: Hop to Cover
fusions.desc: Hops 3 tiles and raises your guard as you land, increasing your armour by 20% for 10 seconds and freeing you of every root, freeze and slow.

fusions.name: Landing Guard
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
